thesis: The podcast discusses Jeaves, a stablecoin-native financial operating system for global enterprises that offers expense management and payment solutions across 25 countries. The speakers argue that Jeaves has built a defensible moat by developing its own infrastructure stack to connect with numerous partners and maintain ledgers across multiple currencies and countries, allowing them to operate without intermediaries in certain card issuance scenarios.
